_doc: AI play-calling preferences. personnel: weight of each offensive personnel group by situation (normal, short = 3 yards or less to go, goalLine = inside the 5, passing = obvious passing down or two-minute). frontFor: defensive fronts the AI answers each personnel group with (base = the team's base front). Tendencies: the AI tracks the opponent's run/pass mix by down and distance; prior = how many league-average calls it starts from; runBias = how far the observed mix can tilt run-defense calls. paBite = play-action bite multiplier: base + perRunRate x the offense's run rate this game. qbRun: designed QB runs and option keeps are weighted by (speed - speedRef) x speedPer, clamped.
